public.name: 霜湾岭国
rules: 整张公开地图可自由通行。逐点移动；道路权重是实验距离单位。水路连接已公开标出，连接线交叉处不能中途换乘。
每项任务含两段。每段先到指定测绘点主动 survey 采集资料，再去支持该资料与本段处理要求的站处理；两段完成后回营地 submit。
本图有十六类资料、二十四种站型。每种站型在自然区域、人类聚居区和动物栖息区各有一座站。
每段同时明确给出“归档编目”或“关联核验”，以及必须前往的处理区域类别。资料类别不限定处理区域：地理资料也可能要求在聚居区处理。
能力由资料与处理要求决定；相同站型在相同要求下的能力跨区域相同。区域是额外的公开地点约束，不改变站型能力。
到访、经过和看地图不揭示站型能力。携带资料主动 process，只揭示该型在本段处理要求下支持的全部资料与本次结果，不揭示另一要求。
到错区域处理时，原始资料保留，阶段不推进，也不揭示站型能力。到正确区域但能力不匹配时，原始资料保留，并交付本次要求下的能力反馈。
基站字母、地名和资料主题不提示隐藏能力。尽量减少道路总距离，距离相同时减少操作。任务结束后的持久记忆由你自主读写。

evaluation.stream_design: 64 ordinary two-stage tasks;32 material/purpose contexts exactly four times. Their four encounters cover all three destination regions, changing region at every repeat. Region is not a new ability or encounter identity;64 survey sites each twice.

survey_assignment_review.method: Fixed-seed survey swaps for physical station usefulness;128 stages,64 survey sites twice, regional sequence and abilities unchanged.

authoring_geometry_check.method: Previously authored station abilities preserved; reducing task count does not resample abilities. Public region constrains physical destination.

provenance.reference_period: c. 1250 CE landscape inspiration; modern geographic reference outline

reference_window.basis: Whole-region reference extent. Not a historical boundary, actual Andes polygon, or walkable-surface measurement.

rationale: Norway/Sweden mainlands and Denmark including Bornholm; excludes the separate Arctic dependencies.
North-up schematic. Fjords/coasts retained from Natural Earth; maritime edges are explicitly ferry links.
Whole-region georeferenced layout; connectivity is an experimental abstraction, not historical-road reconstruction.
All 24 station types have one replica in each of the three publicly drawn processing-region categories.

provenance.scope: Modern reference geography with authored roads, facilities, survey points and mutually exclusive benchmark region partitions. Not a reconstruction of historical transport, population or animal ranges.
